McpPolicyMode.description: What a [`McpPolicy`] grants before `deny` patterns are subtracted.

oneOf.description: Grants exactly the tools matched by the `allow` patterns.
Grants every tool on every registered MCP server, including servers and tools added after the policy is created.

McpPolicyScope.description: Which API keys a [`McpPolicy`] applies to.

oneOf.description: The environment-wide default, applied to keys whose team has no active policy of its own.
A team-level policy, applied to the keys that belong to the team named by `scope_ref`. It replaces the environment default for those keys.

allow.description: Namespaced `<server>__<tool>` patterns granted when `mode` is `selected`. Entries are matched as single-`*` globs, the same form as an API key's `allowed_tools`: `"<server>__*"` grants every tool on one server and an entry without a `*` matches one tool exactly. Ignored for the other modes.

deny.description: Namespaced `<server>__<tool>` patterns subtracted from the effective grant of every key the policy applies to, using the same single-`*` glob matching as `allow`. Deny always wins: a tool matched here stays unavailable even when a team policy or a key's own configuration would otherwise grant it.

enabled.description: Whether the policy is applied. A disabled policy is kept but ignored, exactly like an expired one. Treated as `true` when omitted.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp after which the policy stops applying — it then neither grants nor denies anything. When omitted or set to `null`, the policy never expires.

mode.description: What the policy grants: `none`, `selected` (the `allow` patterns), or `all` current and future tools.

scope.description: Which API keys the policy applies to: the whole environment or one team.

scope_ref.description: Team identifier the policy targets. Required when `scope` is `team`; omitted for an environment-default policy.
